text:
tara: kicking off a focused canary for raven-lite int8 on structured funcalls. mirror-on + 1% live for 18h. goal: validate quantized model doesn't degrade funcall schema compliance or reward score.

devon: timeline + config? also which mitigation is allowed if parse issues show up?

tara: config below, conservative by design. main allowed mitigation is non-invasive post-repair; runtime prefix sanitization only if repair harms RM significantly.

```
{"canary":"raven-lite-int8-struct-check","mirror":true,"live_pct":1,"duration_h":18,"checks":["parse_rate","funcall_exact_match","rm_delta"],"rollback":{"parse_drop_pct":1.0,"funcall_mismatch_pct":0.5},"repair_mode":"conservative"}
```

ellen: FYI last PTQ experiment we saw trailing-token slip (partial `[{` fragments) when kv-compression + int8 kernels combined. worth toggling compression per-shard.

matt: telemetry hook added. I'll stream rm_score_before/after and emit original_vs_repaired in a debug blob for sampled invocations. keep sample size small to avoid PII.

ci-bot: canary job registered: id=canary-7762229999-a. metrics pipeline subscribed.

ops-bot: shard assignment: shard-12. start=2026-03-16T10:02:00Z. runtime tags: kernel=int8, kv_comp=enabled.

devon: 30m in: mirror parse_rate delta -0.35%. small but measurable. sample log: 
```
[10:25:17Z] PARSE_FAIL id=ix-2ab model=raven-lite-int8 reason=prefix_garble
[10:25:17Z] RAW_OUT id=ix-2ab "\n\t, \"tool\": \"search\", \"args\": [\n"
[10:25:17Z] REPAIR_ATTEMPT id=ix-2ab heuristics=[trim_to_first_brace, wrap-array]
[10:25:17Z] REPAIR ok id=ix-2ab
```

ellen: That prefix_garble pattern matches previous kv-compression alignment issue. Can we flip a shard to kv_comp=disabled for A/B?

tara: yes. devon, please flip one canary shard to kv_comp=off and report repair_failure_rate delta.

matt: note: post-repair we saw rm_score_before=0.67 rm_score_after=0.65 for a handful of cases. small RM drop but non-zero. I'll add a histogram label per-repair to see distribution.

ci-bot: telemetry update (2h): baseline_parse=99.20% mirror_parse=98.82% (delta -0.38%). repairs_attempted=84 repairs_success=76 repairs_failed=8. repair_failure_rate=9.5%. rm_delta_median=-0.009.

devon: repair_failure_rate alarmingly high > our 5% soft threshold. compression-off shard flip in progress.

ops-bot: shard-12 (kv_comp=off) deployed.

devon: 40m after toggle: compression-off shard repair_failure_rate=1.4% vs compression-on shard 9.1%. clear signal. raw example from on-shard vs off-shard: on-shard had leading ", \"tool\": token before JSON; off-shard outputs begin with `{`.

matt: good finding. two followups: (1) keep compression-off in canary while we develop a tokenizer alignment micro-fix for compression=on; (2) add a golden-check stream: 2k/h of canonical prompts that must match exact funcall JSON (no repair allowed) or fail canary if mismatch > 0.25%.

tara: agree. add golden_check and hold canary until we have unit test reproducer for the compression bug. if golden_check fails we'll abort live push.

elllen: starting manual review of 30 repaired vs original pairs to check whether repair introduces semantic changes beyond punctuation. posting samples here shortly.

matt: added metric key canary.repair.rm_delta and canary.repair.orig_vs_repaired_count. also tag metrics with canary_id and repair_mode. dashboard ETA 3h.

ci-bot: mid-canary snapshot (8h): mirror_parse_delta -0.22%. rm_delta_median -0.006. repair_failure_rate global=6.8% (reduced after compression-off). golden_check mismatch_rate=0.03% (within threshold).

tara: golden_check passing is reassuring. but repair_failure_rate still > target on old shards so hold compression-off while kernel fix is made. devon, please craft tokenizer alignment unit test that reproduces prefix_garble when kv_comp=on. put test in runtime repo and tag matt for CI.

devon: will author test that simulates kv-compression token chunking and asserts first non-whitespace char is `{` or `[` in structured outputs. will post PR link here.

matt: also recommend adding soft time cap for repair (80ms) on streaming paths to avoid tail latency regressions. postprocess only for non-streaming canary traffic for now.

ops-bot: canary extended to 24h with compression-off. new config recorded.

ci-bot: final snapshot (24h): mirror_parse_delta -0.12%. rm_delta_median -0.004. repair_failure_rate final=1.6% (compression-off). golden_check mismatch_rate=0.01%.

tara: outcome: keep compression disabled in canary builds. devs to land tokenizer alignment fix and unit test. if kernel patch reduces repair_failure_rate to <0.5% with kv_comp=on in a follow-up canary, we can resume normal compression. otherwise consider permanent compression policy change for structured endpoints.

devon: I'll open a short postmortem and link the reproducer and CI test.

elllen: manual audit notes: 30/30 repaired outputs preserved intent; 2/30 had slight ordering differences that RM tolerated. logging samples uploaded to internal bucket.

matt: will file a follow-up canary tracking ticket with metrics and dashboard link and schedule rerun after patch.

ci-bot: canary closed: status=held-for-fix; id=canary-7762229999-a.

tara: thanks all. good triage. next steps: kernel unit test, patch, small canary re-run with compression-on toggle. keep thread for follow-ups.
